title: Cancel two inverse ADDs across chart 115
body:
## Result

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Delete ADD36448 and ADD38004 on public roles 1276 and 751 in exact #7481. Both paid chart-3 to chart-115 MOVEs remain. They implement the same signed linear operator K, including absolute phase, so (K(x−y)+Ky, Ky) = (Kx, Ky) for arbitrary independent inputs.

The literal word drops from 76,475 to 76,473 events. The ordinary upper bound across 17 signed calls drops from 782,785,912 to 782,785,368 source units, saving 544. The paid and productive profiles and the binding crossing are unchanged.

## Sources and replay

Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57, exact #7481 at 89eaa9d8cae37c1540de98f2d29a3abaabb96a2b and signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. The two #7257 CI prerequisite commits are separate ancestors. Both candidate generators agree on canonical SHA-256 dc67987d3d036b19f486a6b030c932c1c01e2ac0edee10be64684ad73564365e.

From a clean POSIX checkout with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-chart115-inverse-add-cancellation/replay.py
```

Expect `PASS_CHART115_INVERSE_ADD_CANCELLATION`. Checks cover 512 signed Gaussian columns in each direction, all 1,501 reverse public input columns, all 1,569 forward rows, 74 owned clear rows, the COPY guard and the common grid. The one-ADD mutant fails at input 751. A one-phase-step mutant fails the absolute-phase check.

Direct, registered and read-only Git-free export replay passed, along with exact source and mode checks and 27 onboarding tests. The tested local commit 84b925cb2d2e4254e38d01d75fba189b6ff4d1f7 has the same complete tree as the PR head. Full changed signed application, precision/tape, BIT and outer checks were outside this component replay.

## Credit and open question

#5265 supplies the inverse ADD method on the older #4610 word, #7003 the forward audit and a distinct retiming method, and #7494 the same-word fixed-peer outward comparison. #7481/#7480/#7334 supply the native and compiler lineage, #7113 the signed caller and #7508 public copies of pinned bytes. Original licenses and notices are retained. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging.

The two retained chart-115 MOVEs act on distinct independent values. A separate paid fusion would need a legal single-role MOVE pair, exact signed action and a positive fully charged price.
